scope: Reference formatting against the ICLR 2027 official template; targeted correction of identified metadata issues, not an exhaustive bibliographic authenticity review.
official_requirements: Natbib author-year citations, et al. for more than two authors.
Consistent reference-entry formatting; APA is not mandated.
Use the current official style and bibliography files.
configuration_findings: Official style supplies natbib author-year round-parenthesis formatting.
Existing cite alias to citep preserves parenthetical citations.
No custom bibliography spacing or font override found.
corrections: Protected capitalization of TEMOS, T2M-GPT, MoMask, 3D, OmniControl, VLAs and RL.
Corrected DDIM from a 2022 arXiv entry to its ICLR 2021 publication, retaining its citation key.
not_required: Manual truncation or expansion of all author lists
